evidence.title: GitHub - vantezzen/shadcn-registry-template: Template repository for building a custom component registry for shadcn/ui · GitHub

name: shadcn-registry-template
summary: Clone-and-edit template for building and publishing a custom shadcn/ui component registry, deployed to GitHub Pages.
description: A template repository that turns your own components into a custom registry for shadcn/ui 2 and later, so users can install them with npx shadcn add <registry url>. Components go in src/components/ui, the registry is declared in registry.ts using shadcn's own syntax (name, type registry:ui or registry:component, registryDependencies, npm dependencies, tailwind config, cssVars, files), and npm run build generates the registry. A Vite demo page documents the components during development, and deployment to GitHub Pages is automatic.
contains: registry declared in registry.ts with shadcn registry syntax
npm run build generates the registry output
Vite demo page for developing components
users install components with npx shadcn add
